q2_gaps: similative "smells / looks / sounds like a N" - the (Like ...) oblique head is explicitly licensed, but nothing says whether the standard NP is a referring witness or the bare kind, so minting sk_locker_room_1 asserts that a particular locker room exists when the comparison is to the kind
notes: locker_room is correctly fused with only its head-noun genus (a noun modifier is never exposed), and Experiencer on the smell-source subject follows the stative-intransitive rule as written even though the place is semantically the stimulus rather than the experiencer.
